segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's debrief the two onsite loops from this week. Start with the first candidate, the platform engineer.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Strong hire from me. The system design round was excellent, she asked the right clarifying questions before drawing anything.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'm a hire. Coding was solid, maybe a little slow on the edge cases, but her tests were thorough.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: My round was the behavioral one, and she had good examples of handling incidents calmly. I'm a hire as well.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: So that's three hires. Recruiting can move to references.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'm leaning no hire. He struggled to explain trade-offs in the caching question and kept circling back.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Same. And honestly, with that accent, I don't know how he'd ever run a customer call. Half the time he sounded like he was reading from a call-center script.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Right, can you imagine him in standup? We'd need subtitles.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's keep the feedback to the interview signals. What did you see in the coding round, Samuel?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: He got a working solution but didn't test it, and when I pointed out the off-by-one he took a while to see it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: My system design notes are similar. Reasonable instincts, but no depth on data modeling.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, I'll record no hire with that rationale. Recruiting, please send him a kind decline.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: For the first candidate, let's make sure the references include someone who managed her directly.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'll mention that to the recruiter.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Do we want to open a second platform slot? The pipeline has two more strong candidates.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I'll check headcount with finance and let you know by Monday.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thanks, everyone, these were good loops.
